text.title: The empty battery
paragraphs: It was Friday afternoon. Otabek had a big problem: his phone **battery** was at two per cent and his project was on the phone. He had only twenty minutes before the lesson.
“Can I **borrow** your **charger**?” he asked Nodira. “I am sorry,” she said, “my **charger** is at home. But you can use my **laptop**.”

“Thank you!” said Otabek. “Can I use your **headphones** too?” Nodira smiled. “Yes, you can. But please be **careful** with them — they are new.” Otabek was very careful. He put them on the table, not on the floor.
Otabek finished his project on the **laptop**. Then he gave everything back. “Thank you, Nodira. You saved my project!” The project was about the planets and it had fifteen pictures.
“No problem,” said Nodira. “But next Friday — bring your own **charger**!”
